style: Realistic documentary photograph of a small Norwegian moving and transport business at work, natural Nordic daylight, muted natural colours, honest everyday working conditions, believable Scandinavian streets, apartment buildings and warehouses, plain unmarked vehicles and boxes, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens.
